name: Worshipping Idols
overview: Scripture clearly forbids the making and worshipping of idols, emphasizing that God alone is to be honored and praised, as He declares His jealousy and refusal to share His glory with graven images (Exodus 20:4; Isaiah 42:8; Deuteronomy 5:9). Idolatry is shown to be futile, as those who trust in carved images worship powerless gods incapable of salvation (Isaiah 45:20). Instead, believers are called to seek first God's kingdom and righteousness, recognizing God as the one true Father in heaven, not turning to earthly substitutes (Matthew 6:33; Matthew 23:9).
